sites.name: MindArk
sites.summary: The developer's company site, captured from October 1999.

sites.name: Project Entropia
sites.summary: MindArk's site for the game: news, client news and release notes, downloads and accounts. It also carried The Gate, MindArk's monthly magazine of 2002 to 2003.

sites.name: Project Entropia forum
sites.summary: MindArk's official forum. Wayback kept about 2,000 of its pages, which were searched for this archive's pictures and release notes.

sites.name: Entropia Universe
sites.summary: The game's site after it became Entropia Universe in 2006: news, release notes and the account site's support pages.

sites.name: Planet Calypso
sites.summary: Planet Calypso's own site, opened with VU 10.0 in August 2009. Its content lists are among the release-note sources on Clients.

sites.name: Entropia HQ
sites.summary: HQ Gaming Network's site for the game, opened in November 2000, with Atrayo as webmaster: news, editorials, an FAQ, interviews and exclusive screenshots. MindArk's own news was posted there as well.

sites.name: Entropia Stratics
sites.summary: Project Entropia's section of the Stratics network: news, contests and a screenshot gallery.

sites.name: Calypso Headquarters
sites.summary: Fan news site, announced in MindArk's news in July 2001, later on the GamingNews network.

sites.name: Future World Relations
sites.summary: Society that published interviews and investigations, and ran a trade point system for its members.

sites.name: pe.drtwister.com
sites.summary: A player's fan page, kept by Wayback in the summer of 2001.

sites.name: RealityPort
sites.summary: Community site with news and a vBulletin forum. Its threads from 2005 to 2009 were read for pictures.

sites.name: SoF (Soldier of Fortune)
sites.summary: Society founded by Buzzi by 2001; its site called it Soldier of Fortune. Wayback kept its pages from 2001 to 2003, and only a placeholder after that.
sites.note: Its archived pages do not name the game; the society's forum posts link them.

sites.name: Z Fighters
sites.summary: Society linked from its members' signatures on the official forum.
sites.note: Its archived pages do not name the game; members' signatures on the official forum link them.

sites.name: New Earth Alliance
sites.summary: One of the first societies; MindArk's news of 29 January 2001 congratulated it on reaching 50 members. Wayback kept its front pages only.

sites.name: C.O.R.P.S. Incorporated
sites.summary: Society founded by ACE; MindArk's news of 19 February 2001 announced its society forum. Wayback kept one page.

sites.name: iLovePE.com
sites.summary: Fan site linked from a player's signature on the official forum. Wayback kept its front page and frame; the address now belongs to a physical education shop.
sites.note: Its archived pages from 2001 do not name the game.

sites.name: OneFootNewb.com
sites.summary: Skits's site, linked from his signature on the official forum: "Perhaps The Newbs Will Shoot themselves in the Foot!" Never captured.

sites.name: Melchior's armoury
sites.summary: Melchior's lists of armour sets and guides, linked from its maker's signature on the official forum.

sites.name: PE Database
sites.summary: A database of the game, linked from the official forum in 2002. Not Recoda's Project Entropia Database.

sites.name: Calypso Independent Auctions
sites.summary: A player-run auction site, advertised on the official forum in 2002.

sites.name: Project Entropia Business Center
sites.summary: Phaelix's player businesses: the Business Center, the Service Center and Uni-Corp.

sites.name: Medicalypso
sites.summary: Tixu Oty's healing service for hunting parties.

sites.name: PE Centre
sites.summary: Linked from the official forum in 2002 as Oasis.

sites.name: Ancient Brotherhood
sites.summary: A guild from other online games that also played Project Entropia, linked on the official forum in 2002.

sites.name: Tyrell Corporation
sites.summary: Society named in Zebadia José Biney's signature on the official forum. Wayback kept its front page only.

sites.name: Swedish Explorer Society (S.E.S)
sites.summary: Swedish society, recruiting on the official forum in June 2002. Wayback kept its front page and one more.

sites.name: Entropia Pioneers
sites.summary: Forum and photo album of the Entropia Pioneers. The largest single source of player screenshots in the archive.

sites.name: spencer.aurig.us
sites.summary: Pages on blueprints and their parts.

sites.name: PE Player
sites.summary: Auction history by item, from before PE Auction.

sites.name: PEStats
sites.summary: A program that read a player's skills and profession standings from screenshots.

sites.name: PE Auction
sites.summary: Recorded the in-game auction from October 2005: every item's sales, markup and statistics, with its own forum (PEABoard) and player auction house (FREEAuction). Its database is gone; the archive has rebuilt its data up to VU 10 from Wayback's captures.

sites.name: PE WikiCharts (Entropedia)
sites.summary: Item wiki with price charts and tools such as armour against mob, armour against weapons and, from 2009, an Armor Adviser. PE Auction's item pages linked to it as PE-Wiki.info in 2006 and as Entropedia.info from 2007.

sites.name: EntropiaForum
sites.summary: Player forum of the Entropia Universe years, renamed PlanetCalypsoForum by 2010. Its archive now lives on as the official forum.

sites.name: PE-Msn
sites.summary: Tigor's tool; its example picture is named for the game's latest news in MSN Messenger. Never captured.

evidence.label: Entropia Universe forum post by tigor, 2005-11-10

sites.name: Entropia Directory
sites.summary: Player wiki, first at pedirectory.info and from 2006 at entropiadirectory.com.

sites.name: The Calypso Post
sites.summary: Published at euforces.com.

sites.name: Hunters Unlimited
sites.summary: Home of Sir Odd's PE Guide.

sites.name: EU beginner guides
sites.summary: Guides for new players with maps and, from 2007, video guides.

sites.name: EntropiaWorld.ru
sites.summary: Russian player community with a forum and gallery.

sites.name: Phoenix Omega
sites.summary: Society with a large forum, in many of its members' signatures on PE Auction's forum.

sites.name: Jurai Blood
sites.summary: Society, recruiting on PE Auction's forum in 2007.

sites.name: Sir Odd's blog
sites.summary: Sir Odd's story of his time in the game, told in chapters; his signature on RealityPort gives "last entry: 3/21/2006 Chapter 10 The Civil War". Never captured.

sites.name: Uber Magazine
sites.summary: A player magazine.

sites.name: RCE Universe
sites.summary: Forum for players of several real-cash economy worlds.

sites.name: Entropia Investment Fund
sites.summary: A player-run investment fund.

sites.name: Entropia Gateway
sites.summary: An information hub for the game, noted by Blue's News at its opening in October 2007.

sites.name: Gandalf's land area tracker
sites.summary: Showed the globals and HoFs dealt out on a land area, as pictures and a monthly leaderboard, starting with Gandalf's own Formicacida area. Never captured.

sites.name: TheEntropians.com
sites.summary: Linked from a player's signature on the PE Auction forum. Wayback kept three pages.

sites.name: Tedt's Furniture Store
sites.summary: Tedt's player furniture shop, in his signature on the PE Auction forum. Wayback kept four pages, one of them a screenshots page.

sites.name: Entropia Tracker
sites.summary: Recorded globals and HoFs by reading players' chat windows, with rankings, signatures and an API; version 2.0 in November 2008.

sites.name: Entropia Top Sites
sites.summary: A ranked list of Entropia sites.

sites.name: Entropia Museum
sites.summary: A present-day site about the early game, with a gallery. It copies older sources, which the archive cites in its place where it can.

sites.name: PE-Assistant (PEAss)
sites.summary: In-game helper with modules: date-stamped screenshots, maps, a calculator, a notepad and a MyTwoPecs price module. A 2007 update broke older versions. Wayback kept its installer 14 times between February 2006 and February 2007.

sites.name: Chipping Optimizer
sites.summary: Worked out the cheapest skills to chip in to reach a profession level; later it included a shop's stock.

sites.name: Skill Scanner
sites.summary: Read a player's skills from screenshots of the skill window; its forum thread ran to 1,380 posts.

sites.name: Project Entropia Database
sites.summary: Offline database of the game in four versions: weapons, armour and much more, with weapon comparisons and a dmg/pec top 15. Version 4 (2006) added the first simulator.

sites.name: Entropia Universe Simulator
sites.summary: Offline hunting simulator: chosen weapon, armour, first-aid pack and skills against a creature, with decay, ammo and a loot pool you could control; version 10 added a PK mode. Recoda later withdrew it.

sites.name: PERC and Pricefinder
sites.summary: Starfinder's site of tools, among them Pricefinder, a price database. Its source code and database were released in 2005 when the site was about to close.

sites.name: Entropia Tools
sites.summary: Web skill calculator and inventory compare.

sites.name: EU Companion
sites.summary: Captured a player's skills from screenshots or straight from the game.

sites.name: Profession Screen Scanner
sites.summary: Read the profession window from a screenshot; source included.

sites.name: Skill Market Value Calculator
sites.summary: Spreadsheet valuing skills in ESIs at PE Auction's prices.

sites.name: PECharts loot database
sites.summary: Which mobs drop which items, entered by players; it passed 1,000 items in July 2005.

sites.name: Kn00b Stats
sites.summary: Web tracker of a hunt's wins and losses, used alongside PE-Assistant.

sites.name: Weapon calculator
sites.summary: Compared weapons' economy with a player's skills, minimum damage and miss rate.

sites.name: Fap efficiency chart
sites.summary: Heal per second and per PEC of every first-aid pack for a player's own heal multiplier.

sites.name: Wanderers Hunting Calculator
sites.summary: Web hunting statistics (WHC).

sites.name: Online Huntlog
sites.summary: Loot per hit point by mob and maturity, from players' own records.

sites.name: Real Economy Calculator
sites.summary: Web calculator of hunting economy.

sites.name: (L) item remaining uses calculator
sites.summary: Shots left in a limited weapon from its remaining TT value.

sites.name: NeoMap
sites.summary: Mapping program for miners, the model for seamaster's EU Map.

sites.name: EU Map
sites.summary: Mapping program for miners; version 1.0 in September 2006.

sites.name: NRF (No Resources Found)
sites.summary: Logged mining runs, finds and skill progress; its forum thread ran to 741 posts.

sites.name: entropiaminers.com
sites.summary: Shared NRF mining logs as a claim database.

sites.name: Mine-A-Loot
sites.summary: Mining logger; version 2.0, Mine-A-Loot-More, in 2008.

sites.name: iFound
sites.summary: Claim logging with maps and sharing.

sites.name: Ore Logger
sites.summary: Read chat.log to log mining claims into a shared map.

sites.name: Mining log spreadsheet
sites.summary: Mining log and chart, hosted on Entropia Directory.

sites.name: Online ore and enmatter calculator
sites.summary: Web calculator of resource values. Wayback kept the portal it was on but not the calculator.

sites.name: Mining maps
sites.summary: Resource maps sold through entropiaoutfitters.com.

sites.name: MyTwoPecs
sites.summary: Auction price graphs; PE-Assistant had a MyTwoPecs price module.

sites.name: Irken Invaders
sites.summary: Society site with auction price graphs, home of Squee's NRF.

sites.name: Trading Center spreadsheet
sites.summary: A virtual warehouse and trade sheets.

sites.name: EU Trader
sites.summary: Item manager and trade records.

sites.name: Price
sites.summary: A small price calculator. Wayback kept its maker's programs page only in 2003 and 2006, before it was announced.

sites.name: Entropia Trade Calculator
sites.summary: Auction fees, markup after fees and a shop calculator, in versions 1.0 to 1.42.

sites.name: Ped Market Trader Tool
sites.summary: Trading tool.

sites.name: Fast Trade
sites.summary: Scanned the materials in the trade window and totalled them at a player's own markups.

sites.name: Auction Scanner
sites.summary: Read the auction's pages from the screen.

sites.name: Auction Lot Optimizer
sites.summary: Worked out the best lot size to sell after the auction fee.

sites.name: C.O.R.E. Price Tracker
sites.summary: Read the game's market values into a database of auction prices.

sites.name: EntropiaBay
sites.summary: Inventory calculator, auction data and signatures.

sites.name: Inventeer
sites.summary: Inventory tables in Excel and XML.

sites.name: EU Inventory Database
sites.summary: Statistics from inventories pasted from the account site.

sites.name: Entropia Tracker client
sites.summary: The program that read the chat window for Entropia Tracker.

sites.name: Eunalysis
sites.summary: Global statistics from BruuD's own chat-reading program, whose method BruuD shared.

sites.name: EntropiaPlaces.com
sites.summary: Map of mobs, teleporters and resources on Google Maps.

sites.name: Colour Pre-Visualisation Tool
sites.summary: Previewed colours on clothes.

sites.name: PilotPusher
sites.summary: Booking system for pilots; discontinued for lack of use.

sites.name: Game Land Database
sites.summary: Register of who owned land in Entropia and other worlds.

sites.name: EntropiaStreet.com
sites.summary: Directory of players' shops, services and events.

sites.name: Furniture Database
sites.summary: Online database of the game's furniture.

sites.name: Peci
sites.summary: Project Entropia Cinema Interface: players' films, rated and hosted.

sites.name: Entropia Exposed
sites.summary: A player magazine.
